main_text.l: לָחַם Vesci: Pugnare, Impugnare, Oppugnare. Niphal נִלְחַם Pugnare: cum ב construCtum, Cum aliquo, cum עַל, Contra aliquem; cum ל, Fro aliquo.
לֶחֶם m. Panis, Cibus. Chald. idem: item Convivium: עבד לֶחֶם רַב Fecit convivium magnum, Dan.5.1.
לָחָם m. Oppugnator: cum Segol loco Tzere.
לְחוּם m. Cibus, Epulum: Caro, Corpus.
מִלְחָמָה f. Bellum, Pugna: plur. מִלְחָמוֹת.
לְחָנָה לַחַן f. Chald. Concubina, Pellex.
לָחַץ Premere, Opprimere. Niphal נִלְחַץ Arctare, Comprimere se.
לָחַשׁ Musitare; Incantare: Hithpahel הִתְלַחֵשׁ Idem.
לַחַשׁ m. Musitatio, Oratio submissa: Incantatio: plurale, לְחָשִׁים Amuleta.
לָטַשׁ Acuit, Polivit: Erudivit. Ex Pyhal מְלֻטָּשׁ Expolitus, Acutus.
לַיְלָה, לַיִל m. Nox: plural. לֵילוֹת. Chald. לֵילְיָא Nox.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing in several headwords is uncertain at this scan quality; Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible. No marginal notes are printed. Page number 162 is printed at the top right. The catchword לכ is at the lower right.
